messages:
olivia: Quick sync: post-RFC follow-up on auth boundary simplification. Found gaps in project->org permission inheritance. TL;DR: we need explicit deny zones for infra services.

samir: Can you sketch the gap? example?

olivia: Yes — runtime use case: billing worker uses project API key that currently inherits org-level `read_time_series` role; that allows it to list org billing buckets. We want to block that.

yuki: I thought project keys were isolated? sounds like stale fallback tokens are leaking.

raj: Probable cause: our legacy proxy treats missing scope as `auth.default_scope = org:read` fallback. Example config: `auth.default_scope = "org:read"`

olivia: Exactly. Options: A) tighten default to empty (deny-all) and fail fast  B) explicit per-service shim that maps project->project-only claims  C) runtime token exchange for short-lived project tokens.

samir: Tradeoffs: A is safest but breaks clients. B keeps compat but more surface area to maintain. C adds infra complexity (token broker).

tina: Metrics: we saw ~0.6% of signed ops rely on 'default org' today. If we flip A we'll spike 400+ errors in 2 teams.

yuki: Proposal: rollout in two phases: phase1 dark traffic check + metric alert; phase2 opt-in deny-all for teams; phase3 enforced deny-all. Also provide `rw:proxy-fallback=off` flag.

olivia: Agree. Also we should add an allowlist for infra services (k8s controllers) that need org read.
Plan: create migration playbook + `auth:warn` header to help SDKs.

raj: Implementation note: adjust policy evaluation order so explicit denies win. Current code uses first-match; need to change to 'deny overrides' semantics.

samir: Heads-up: changing evaluation order could affect rate-limiter service. We need unit tests & simulation harness. I'll add to eng-sre backlog.

tina: Shall we surface a deprecation banner in Console and in API responses? `Warning: default scope will be removed on 2026-08-01`

olivia: :thumbsup: I'll draft migration email + RFC follow-up doc. Assign owners: olivia (lead), samir (runtime), raj (authz tests), yuki (telemetry), tina (comms).

sec-bot: Auto: created task #SEC-872: 'Project default-scope removal rollout' assigned to olivia.

olivia: Thanks. Next checkpoint EOW for dark traffic numbers.
